resources.string:
1. Give permission to Display Over Other Apps.
 2. Choose your default Translation language.
 3. Choose your AI engine:
 • Online AI — Paste your own OpenRouter API key. The free version is enough for daily queries.
 • On-Device AI — Download a supported local AI model and use it directly on your device.
 4. Close Skip AI completely (including from recent apps).
 5. Go to Settings >> Accessibility >> Skip AI >> turn on Accessibility permission.
 6. Test it by selecting text in any supported app. Skip AI will show the floating AI options.

 Note: Accessibility permission is required for the selected-text floating window feature. On some devices, Accessibility permission may turn off automatically when Skip AI is closed. If this happens, enable it again after closing the app.

Skip AI uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to detect selected text and active input fields across apps.
This allows Skip AI to: • Read text you select for Ask AI, Summarize, Simplify, or Translate. • Detect focused text inputs to write and insert AI responses. • Show the floating assistant over apps you use.
Skip AI DOES NOT: • Perform automated gestures, touches, clicks, or screen navigation. • Access your camera, control device hardware, or perform payments. • Record your screen or continuously collect data in the background.
Your selected text is processed only when you request an AI action. Skip AI is open-source, and you can disable this permission at any time in Android Settings.
